learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to use Pronouns (I, we, you, he, she, it, they) in place of nouns to make sentences sound better.]
warm_up_hook: 🦸‍♂️ Imagine saying: 'Rohan picked up Rohan's bag and Rohan went to school.' That sounds so silly and repetitive! Enter the Pronouns—our superhero words that rescue us from repeating names!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Pronoun is a word that takes the place of a noun. We use pronouns so we don't have to say the same name over and over again.
examples_or_templates: Without Pronoun: Priya is singing because Priya is happy.
With Pronoun: Priya is singing because [she] is happy.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we talk about just ONE person, animal, or thing, we use Singular Pronouns: I, You, He, She, and It.
examples_or_templates: [It] is for one animal or thing.
[I] and [You] are for ourselves and the person we are talking to.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we talk about MORE THAN ONE person, animal, or thing, we use Plural Pronouns: We, You, and They.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which pronoun will replace the underlined words? '<u>Ravi and Amit</u> are playing football.'
❓ Which pronoun do we use for a non-living thing like a 'Car'?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Replace the underlined word with a pronoun: <u>My mother</u> makes the best cake.
subjective_practice.hint: Your mother is one woman. Which singular female pronoun should you use?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: Tom and I are brothers. ______ share the same room.
subjective_practice.hint: When you are included in the group, what pronoun do you use? (We or They?)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rewrite the sentence using a pronoun: 'The dog is barking because the dog is hungry.'
subjective_practice.hint: Replace the second 'the dog' with a singular pronoun for animals.

activity_or_assignment.title: 👉 The Pronoun Pointing Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Point to yourself and say 'I'. Point to your friend and say 'You'. Point to a boy and say 'He'. Point to a group of people and say 'They'. Do this for 2 minutes to memorize them!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Pronouns are words used instead of nouns to avoid repeating names.
⭐ He, She, It, I, You are Singular Pronouns (for one).
⭐ We, They, You are Plural Pronouns (for many).
⭐ 'It' is used for animals and non-living things.
